chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 2025: the Nations League final, Portugal against Spain. Nuno Mendes flies up the left wing, right past Lamine Yamal. He crosses… and Cristiano Ronaldo volleys it in!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Nuno sprints down the outside, and Yamal cannot keep up. He looks up and whips in a cross.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: It flicks off a defender and drops behind Cucurella. Ronaldo holds him off and volleys it in. Two–two! Portugal won the final on penalties!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Remember Nuno: sprint past your winger on the outside, and they have an easy pass!
